Invoice-list pagination is complete and verified. `InvoicePage` is defined in schemas, `InvoiceService.list_invoices` accepts bounded pagination, and `/invoices` validates `limit`/`offset`, calculates totals within the same session, and returns a paginated envelope. Added `tests/api/test_invoice_pagination.py` for middle pages, out-of-range offsets, and invalid inputs. Ruff, `git diff --check`, the billing suite (18 tests), and report tests (18 tests) pass.

A report performance investigation found that `ledgerly/reports/invoice_summary.py` had an N+1 query pattern: nested tenant/currency loops repeatedly loaded invoices. Instrumentation for tenant 73 showed 1,024 rows fetched via 2,431 statements in 37.9 seconds. `ReportContext` already exposes the required account and date fields, so no public report API change is needed. The implementation was updated to filter invoices once outside the currency loop and aggregate them with `Sum("amount")`, reducing the report from 14 per-currency queries to one aggregate query per account. The patch passed `git diff --check`; it changes one file with 27 insertions and 19 deletions. Further optimization verification, including relevant report tests and performance checks, remains useful.

Earlier completed work includes the committed invoice-sync idempotency race fix with regression, integration, repository, Ruff, and load-test coverage. Pending items include export configuration using `ledgerly-exports-vault-84`, API-key rotation, CI threshold work, S3 decommissioning follow-up, and tax readiness. Dry-run bulk ledger operations, richer idempotency metadata, invoice numbering review, decimal property tests, and other deferred improvements are future considerations only.
